task.title: Recover from a missing profile route
task.shortdesc: Recover when a bookmark, stale tab, or editor URL reports Profile not found.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: A missing profile route means the URL no longer resolves to an active profile; the profile may be archived, deleted, filtered out, or already removed.

step.cmd: Return to the Library instead of editing the failed route.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Clear search and filters, then look for the profile by name, schema channel, and last known status.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Include archived profiles when the profile may have been archived deliberately.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: If the profile is still missing, stop using the stale URL and continue only from a visible Library row or known export.

info.note: Retry only from the BPM interface; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: You either reopen the profile from a visible Library state or confirm that the bookmarked route is no longer usable.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
